observations: The game's real sceFont_Library accepts the patch-owned font and draws glyphs.
The main menu description panel renders its translated Korean paragraph.
The autosave notice renders '메모리 스틱 듀오' followed by the trademark sign.
A newly translated string ('스킬이 선택되지 않았습니다') appears on the mission screen.
not_verified: mission condition digits after the 2026-09-26 digit-table fix

font_control.approach: repurpose an unused sceFont import slot for sceFontOpenUserFile and load the font with disc0:
font_control.decoder_change: Hangul base moved from 0xAC00 to 0x0100 so the font character map stays small
font_control.size_limit: the game's libfont renders up to about 165KB; 235KB still opens but draws nothing
font_control.header_rule: header bytes 32, 33 and 372 are alignment divisors inside the real libfont; zero makes it trap
font_control.charmap_rule: unmapped character map slots must hold (1 << bpe) - 1, the way kr0.pgf does, or glyph 0 is drawn

reserved_indices.8226: the %t token substitutes a trademark sign here
reserved_indices.207-216: the decimal digit table at 0x28D3B4 is read two bytes per digit
reserved_indices.12000: U+CC22 moved here because its natural index collides with %t

known_issues: MS-edit skill-description problems were recorded in the prior handoff; current scene/source not re-established. PZZ origin and index collision remain hypotheses.
Menu labels and unit names are GIM images, not font text.
Whole-game text and NEXT PLUS graphic localization remain incomplete.

notation_policy.english: kept as English; the patch ships its own font
notation_policy.digits: ASCII digits; the digit table in the game data stays two bytes per entry
notation_policy.gundam_title_logos: Original source appearance; excluded from Korean lettering at user request 2026-10-03
